summary_en: SBINM LLC (SBI Holdings subsidiary) completed a tender offer for BASE Inc. shares that ended on October 21, 2026. A total of 90,944 shares were tendered, below the upper limit of 23,792,300 shares. The company will remain listed on TSE Growth Market post-transaction and will discuss future capital partnership arrangements with SBI Holdings.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Tender Offer for Shares of BASE Inc. by SBINM LLC (Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of SBI Holdings Inc.)
translation_en_brief:
SBINM LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of SBI Holdings Inc., completed a tender offer for ordinary shares of BASE Inc. on October 21, 2026. The offer period ran from August 31, 2026, to October 21, 2026. A total of 90,944 shares were tendered in the offer, which was below the upper limit of 23,792,300 shares set for the tender offer, resulting in full acquisition of all tendered shares.

The tender offer was conducted as part of a capital and business partnership agreement between BASE and SBI Holdings entered into on August 28, 2026. BASE's board of directors expressed support for the tender offer on a basis of response-neutral opinion. The company stated that the partnership aimed to establish BASE as an equity method affiliate of SBI Holdings to strengthen medium and long-term cooperation and advance growth strategy.

Following completion of the tender offer, BASE Inc. will maintain its listing on the TSE Growth Market. However, since the number of shares acquired fell short of the threshold required for BASE to qualify as an equity method affiliate, the company and SBI Holdings will discuss the future structure of their capital and business partnership.
